# Building a page

## Before you start

Read the closest existing page (the platform console pages and the marketing hubs are the
cleanest), the UI kit components it uses in `src/components/ui/`, and its tests. Pages here
have **one job**; if you are adding a fourth concern to a page, propose splitting it
instead.

## Two audiences, one route tree

| Area | Routes | Shell |
|---|---|---|
| Public marketing | `/`, `/features`, `/features/$slug`, `/solutions`, `/solutions/$slug`, `/pricing`, `/about`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/refund-policy` | `marketing/MarketingLayout.tsx` |
| Household | `/dashboard` (alias `/app`), `/requests`, `/requests/escalation`, `/places`, `/places/console`, `/members`, `/members/roles`, `/members/invitations`, `/billing`, `/recurring`, `/money`, `/money/$ledgerId`, `/settings`, `/feedback` | `AppLayout` |
| Landlord console | `/admin`, `/admin/tenants`, `/admin/tenants/$tenantId`, `/admin/analytics`, `/admin/billing`, `/admin/payment-gateways`, `/admin/email-config`, `/admin/refunds`, `/admin/marketing`, `/admin/settings`, `/admin/profile`, `/admin/health`, `/admin/backups`, `/admin/feedback`, `/admin/audit-logs` | `AppLayout` |
| Auth | `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/verify-email`, `/verify-phone`, `/admin/login` | `AuthLayout` |

Marketing content lives in `src/pages/marketing/` (`marketingData.ts` drives feature and
solution detail pages) and has a static twin in `../Website/` — update both.

## Composition

```tsx
export function ThingPage() {
  const query = useQuery({ queryKey: ['tenant', 'thing', filters], queryFn: … });

  return (
    <AppLayout>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <PageHeader breadcrumb={[…]} title="…" description="…" actions={…} />
        {error && <Alert>{apiError(query.error)}</Alert>}
        {/* metric strip, then content, then states */}
      </div>
    </AppLayout>
  );
}
```

- States are part of the page: loading (`SkeletonCard`), empty (`EmptyState` — say what
  belongs here and how to fill it), error (`Alert` + `apiError`, or `QueryError`), and data.
- Use the kit, not raw markup: `Alert`, `Avatar`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Card`, `Chip`,
  `EmptyState`, `Input`, `Label`, `Modal`, `PageHeader`, `QueryError`, `Select`, `Skeleton`,
  `Table`.
- Style from the theme. Tokens live in `src/index.css`; never hardcode a hex.

## Queries

- Query keys are grouped by area: `['tenant', …]`, `['platform', …]`, `['billing', …]`,
  `['ledgers', …]`, `['requests', 'board']`, `['feedback']`. **Never include a
  `Date.now()`-derived value** — it changes every render and refetches forever. Derive
  time windows with `useMemo` keyed on the real input.
- Mutations invalidate the area key (`invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['platform', 'billing'] })`)
  rather than refetching by hand.
- Surface failures with `apiError(error)` so validation messages reach the user verbatim.
- Plan caps and usage come from `useQuota()` (`GET /v1/tenant/quotas`); `src/lib/plans.ts`
  is only the fallback so a meter never renders blank mid-load.

## Guards

`requireAuth` → any signed-in user. `requireTenant` → additionally needs an active
household. `requirePlatformAdmin` → the landlord console. A platform admin has **no tenant**,
so anything tenant-scoped must be hidden behind `!is_platform_admin`; the shell does this for
the household switcher, status badge and Add Request. Signing in as a platform admin lands
on `/admin`, not `/dashboard`.

## Accessibility floor

- Every control has an accessible name; icon-only buttons need `aria-label` or a visually
  hidden label.
- `aria-pressed` on toggles, `aria-expanded` on disclosure, `role="dialog"` +
  `aria-modal` on overlays (the `Modal` component already does this).
- Never colour alone — pair it with text or an icon.
- Focus rings stay visible; the global `:focus-visible` rule is deliberate.

## Testing traps (each of these has cost real time)

- **`tests/setup.ts` must not import stores or `@/lib/api`.** It runs before a test file's
  `vi.mock` applies, so the store caches live axios and the guard hits the network. Reset
  state with `tests/support/session.ts`.
- **Await anything from the API** (`await screen.findBy…`); headers render before
  react-query resolves.
- **Scope queries.** Filter `<option>` lists repeat table-row strings, and metric labels
  collide with column headings — use `within(...)`, or give the region an `aria-label`
  (the kanban summary strip uses `aria-label="Board summary"` for exactly this reason).
- **jsdom is pinned to 26**; v27 breaks Vitest's fork pool.

## Definition of done

`npm run build` clean, `npm test` green with a test in the matching layer, `npm run typecheck`
clean. Report the commands and their output.
